explanation: The requested phi* = 370 deg is outside the conventional [0,360) range, but azimuthal angle is periodic with period 360 deg, so 370 deg is physically identical to phi* = 10 deg. I normalized phi* to 10 deg (370 - 360) before running the preflight check and generating the EXCLURAD input file. All other kinematics (W = 1.7 GeV, Q2 = 1.0 GeV^2, cos(theta*) = 0.5) passed preflight checks (production threshold, pole safety, Q2 positivity, beam-energy accessibility, and lookup-table coverage) with no warnings. The input file was generated for the eta channel using the CLAS12 RG-K beam energy default (6.53 GeV), the campaign the validated eta reference data came from; other CLAS12 beam energies (10.6 GeV for RG-A, 10.2 GeV for RG-B) are also valid but yield different radiative corrections. rc_mode = full (validated O(alpha) calculation) and vcut = 0.166 GeV^2 (channel default) were used.
